name: October Pharma
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing) | gap-filled 2026-10-07 from stockanalysis.com EGX income statement | EGXGAP 17 Nov 2026: the audited FY2025 results were published on the Egyptian Exchange and carry net profit EGP 205,723,937 against an audited FY2024 comparative of EGP 151,838,850 (October Pharma, disclosure EGS380R1C018, audit status audited, mirrored at https://english.mubasher.info/news/4580040/October-Pharma-OCPH-CA-Reports-Year-Ended-31-12-2025-Results and https://askborsa.com/en/company/OCPH/fy-2025, both read 17 Nov 2026). The stored FY2024 net profit of EGP 151,840,000 reproduces that audited comparative, so the stored series is consistent with the filing. No FY2025 period is appended here: the disclosure publishes the net profit and the board report but the exchange attachments are image-only scans (zero extractable characters, OCR recovers only letterhead), so revenue, cost of sales, operating lines, tax and EPS for FY2025 could not be read and writing a column with one populated cell and nine blanks would misrepresent the year. Fill this year only from the filing or a machine-readable annual report. | CRON 2026-11-28: FY2025 column added. Figures printed by two independent providers, not derived except where tagged. Revenue, Gross Profit and the Cost of Sales difference are from the Reuters LSEG annual income statement (millions EGP, converted to absolute EGP); Net Profit is the audited figure published in the company's own Egyptian Exchange results disclosure. Rows not printed by any reachable free source (Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT), Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax, Income Tax, EPS) are left empty rather than estimated; the free EGX summaries publish only the top and bottom line. The stored earlier years reproduce the same provider exactly on the overlapping year, which is why these rows are on the same basis. Carrier of the FY2025 figures: Reuters/LSEG annual income statement lists 2025 revenue 1,482.84 million EGP, gross profit 619.51 million and net income 205.72 million; the stored FY2024 revenue 1,228,000,000 and gross profit 523,390,000 reproduce the provider's 2024 column exactly. Net profit 205,723,937 EGP for the year ended 31 December 2025 is the audited figure in the company's EGX results disclosure of 18 March 2026, whose 2024 comparative 151,838,850 matches the stored FY2024 value. Cost of Sales is Revenue less Gross Profit from the two printed figures.
note: Figures in the unit shown, converted from the provider's millions EGP. Each fiscal year header cell was matched to its own data cell, so the provider trailing twelve month column is excluded. Every printed identity ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit.
